title: williamsOttoPlant operation
description: The Williams-Otto plant of choupoCtrl: a CSTR plus separator reduced to the paper's six-state model (eqs. (3.6)-(3.11) of arXiv:2004.07614, verbatim; klb, h and degR internally, converted at the boundary with 1 kmol == 1 klb). The starting inventory is the unit's `initial {}` block (T, optional P, totalMoles and a composition over the six species); this `operation` block holds the CONTROLS of the paper's eq. (3.16): the two feed rates, the recycle/purge flow and the reactor-temperature fraction (WilliamsOttoPlant.cpp:97-101). All four keys are read without a default.

F_fA.title: Feed rate of reactant A
F_fA.description: Declared as a molar flow (`10 kmol/h` is accepted); the unit multiplies the SI value by 3600 to get klb/h. No default (WilliamsOttoPlant.cpp:98).

F_fB.title: Feed rate of reactant B
F_fB.description: As F_fA, for reactant B (WilliamsOttoPlant.cpp:99). A controller's actuator may drive it.

mu.title: Recycle / purge flow mu
mu.description: The paper's mu control, a molar flow, as F_fA (WilliamsOttoPlant.cpp:100).

eta.title: Reactor temperature fraction eta
eta.description: The paper's eta control; refused outside [0, 1] (WilliamsOttoPlant.cpp:101-104).
